sn47.14:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Vajjīsu viharati Ukkacelāyaṃ Gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhim aciraparinibbutesu Sāriputta-Moggalānesu || || 2.
sn47.14:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā bhikkhu-saṅghaparivuto ajjhokāse nisinno hoti || ||
sn47.14:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tunhībhūtam bhikkhusaṅgham anuviloketvā bhikkhū āmantesi || || 3.
sn47.14:2.2: Api myāyam bhikkhave parisā suññā viya khāyati || parinibbutesu Sāriputta-Moggalānesu
sn47.14:2.3: suññā me bhikkhave parisā hoti || anapekkhā tassam disāyam hoti yassaṃ dīsāyaṃ Sāriputta-Moggalānā viharanti || || 4.
sn47.14:2.4: Ye hi te bhikkhave ahesum atītamadhānam arahanto sammāsambuddhā || tesam pi bhagavantānam etaparamam yeva sāvakayugam ahosi ||
sn47.14:2.6: Ye pi te bhikkhave bhavissanti anāgatam addhānam arahanto sammāsambuddhā || tesam pi bhagavantānam etaparamaṃ yeva sāvakayugam bhavissati || seyyathāpi mayhaṃ Sāriputta-Moggalānā || || 5.
sn47.14:2.7: Acchariyam bhikkhave sāvakānam abbhutam bhikkhave sāvakānam
sn47.14:2.8: satthu ca nāma sāsanakarā bhavissanti ovādapatikarā || catunnaṃ ca parisānam piyā bhavissanti manāpā garū ca bhāvaniyā ca || ||
sn47.14:2.9: Acchariyam bhikkhave Tathāgatassa abbhutam bhikkhave Tathāgatassa ||
sn47.14:2.10: evarūpe pi nāma sāvakayuge parinibbute natthi Tathāgatassa soko vā paridevo vā ||
sn47.14:2.11: tam kutettha bhikkhave labbhā || yantaṃ jātaṃ bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ palokadhammaṃ taṃ vata ma palujjīti
sn47.14:2.13: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato ye mahantatarā khandhā te palujjeyyuṃ ||
sn47.14:2.14: Evam eva kho bhikkhave mahato bhikkhusaṅghassa tiṭṭhato sāravato Sāriputta-Moggalānā parinibbutā ||
sn47.14:2.15: taṃ kutettha bhikkhave labbhā || yan taṃ jātam bhūtam saṅkhatam palokadhammaṃ taṃ vata mā palujjīti ||
sn47.14:2.17: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave attadīpā viharathā- -anaññasaraṇā || || 8.
sn47.14:3.7: Ye hi keci bhikkhave etarahi vā mamaccaye vā attadīpā viharissanti- -tamatagge bhikkhave bhikkhu bhavissanti ye keci sikkhākāmā ti || || 1.
